svg.title: Study design: shared network and the reach-matched test
svg.desc: Panel a: four input domains, per-domain encoders, a softmax gate, graph message passing for the GNN, a linear head and the TROPOMI NO2 target; the no-graph network and SLX models take box means of the inputs instead. Panel b: the thesis compared a GNN that sees 22.7 km with SLX models that see 12.6 km, so the graph and the reach differed at once. This study gives the GNN, the same network without a graph and SLX models the same reach, varies it from 0 to 37.8 km, and evaluates all of them in the same way.
svg.text: Inputs, fusion network and target (all neural models)
No-graph network: the neighbourhood enters here,
as box means of each input.
SLX: the same inputs and box means go to OLS, GBM or RF.
From the original comparison to the test in this study

and how far the model sees.
shown at 22.7 km; also compared at 7.6, 15.1, 30.3 and 37.8 km
reach (km): how far from a cell a prediction can look
Same evaluation for all: 12 blocks of 22 km, 2-km buffer · held-out year 1404 · five seeds
Spearman (primary), PR-AUC · sign-flip test, jackknife, ±0.02 equivalence, Holm
